newsitem.title: UK: IRA admits killing two N.Irish policemen.
newsitem.headline: IRA admits killing two N.Irish policemen.

text.p: The outlawed Irish Republican Army (IRA) admitted responsibility on Monday for shooting dead two policemen in the Northern Ireland town of Lurgan.
A caller using an IRA identity code telephoned a Belfast radio station saying its members killed the officers who were on routine foot patrol close to the town centre.
The caller said that the attack was carried out by "the North Armagh Brigade" of the IRA.
The killings cast a deep gloom over the British province's peace hopes and threatened a ceasefire by pro-British Loyalist guerrillas which has been in force for three years.
The IRA, which wants to end British rule and unite the island of Ireland, ended a truce in February 1996 with a bomb in London's Docklands district.
